title: Credential adapter + compact stream facade: ergonomic surface simplification and cross-SDK parity
author: Evelyn Park
release_notes:
- Introduce CredAdapter abstraction for credential lookup/fallback across Python/TS/Go SDKs.
- Add compact StreamFacade with simplified async iterator helpers and clearer cancel semantics.
- Bump SDK versions: python 2.1.0, typescript 1.8.0, go 1.4.3.
- Non-breaking: default behavior preserved; opt-in for new facade via the `use_compact_facade` flag.
description:
Motivation: SDK surface area for authentication and streaming has drifted between language implementations. This PR introduces a small, focused credential adapter abstraction and a compact StreamFacade that harmonizes cancel/heartbeat/retry ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go without forcing a large refactor in consumers. The goal is parity for common paths (token lookup, delegated refresh, short-circuit fallbacks) and a simpler async iterator model for streaming responses.

What this changes (high level):
- Introduced `CredAdapter` interface (language-specific names: CredAdapter, CredProvider, cred_adapter) which centralizes token lookup, optional prefetch, and deterministic TTL handling. Implementations are provided for existing token sources (env, file, delegated-refresh endpoint).
- Added `StreamFacade` (compact facade) that wraps lower-level streaming transports to provide: cancelable async iteration, built-in exponential-jitter retry presets for transient network errors, and a consistent `close()`/`abort()` surface. SDKs expose this behind a `use_compact_facade` opt-in flag to allow staged rollouts.
- Small compatibility shim to map legacy per-language retry presets to a unified RetryInterpretation layer; existing presets are preserved but now routed through a common adapter so cross-language behavior matches more closely.
- Tests: end-to-end smoke tests added by language; new unit tests for CredAdapter fallback chains and for retry predicate mapping.

Commits (summary):
- e3f5a1c: add cred_adapter interfaces and python implementation with integration tests
- b2d4be7: typescript cred adapter + adapter tests, bump ts-sdk version
- 9c7d9f0: go cred provider, small helper for TTL parsing, go-sdk bump
- 1a8ff21: implement StreamFacade wrapping transport layer, add doc examples
- 5d4b0a2: map legacy retry presets into unified RetryInterpretation helper; add telemetry tags
- c3f7a90: CI flake fixes, test retries for intermittent HTTP 502 responses

Changed areas / files (representative):
- src/sdk/common/cred_adapter.py (new)
- src/sdk/python/stream_facade.py (new)
- packages/sdk-ts/src/cred/adapter.ts (new)
- packages/sdk-ts/src/stream/facade.ts (new)
- modules/go-sdk/cred/adapter.go (new)
- docs/sdk/compact-facade.md (updated examples and migration notes)
- tests/integration/stream_similarity_test.py (new)

Testing and CI notes:
- Initial CI run flagged two flaky stream tests in the TypeScript matrix (timeout-related). Increased default per-chunk timeout and added deterministic backoff jitter seed for tests.
- After fixes, full CI passed: unit, integration, lint, and e2e smoke in Python/TS/Go.

Review conversation (high level):
- Asha: requested clearer migration doc and an explicit deprecation timeline for legacy stream helpers. Suggested adding example of opt-in flag and a short migration script for TypeScript consumers.
- Author (Evelyn): added docs/sdk/compact-facade.md with examples and a short migration snippet for both iterator and callback consumers. Clarified that default remains legacy facade.
- Miguel: asked for more explicit telemetry tags to make canary comparisons easier; added `sdk.facade=compact` and `sdk.cred_adapter=unified` to critical paths.
- Dana: requested a unit test asserting parity for a common retry scenario; added `tests/integration/stream_similarity_test.py` which runs parallel scripted clients using python and ts SDKs against the same mock service and compares retry counts and time-to-first-byte.

Backward compatibility and rollout plan:
- Default behavior is unchanged. The compact facade is opt-in for now and gated behind the `use_compact_facade` option in SDK constructors/config. We plan a gradual rollout: enable behind flags in internal canaries for two weeks, gather telemetry, then flip default for minor release 30 days after merging if no regressions.

Related work: ENG-4921 (SDK parity project), ENG-4988 (stream ergonomics spike), SUP-1142 (customer-reported stream cancel behavior).

Merge: Squash merge to main after final CI; release notes included in the changelog and SDK bumps pushed to package registries.

If follow-ups are required: create smaller follow-ups for (1) telemetry dimension expansion for routing, (2) optional prefetch strategy tuning in CredAdapter, and (3) an example migration for serverless quickstarts that use streaming heavily.
